input: Frame a paper from interviews with delivery workers. It characterizes their routines and reported pressures. We have no evidence for how platform incentives cause these pressures. Must we add a new theory to contribute?
Twelve households used our technology probe; no comparison condition. They discussed new communication possibilities. Revise: Our intervention improved family communication.
We reconstruct how user-friendly became an organizational ideal from archival documents. No participants or new system. Suggest an appropriate outline and evidence limits.

Three-year community co-design collaboration. Workshops were researcher-led; partners chose deployment locations. Maintenance continued through unpaid partner labor. Draft the contribution framing; do not assume empowerment.

We classified 20 million platform posts. Toxicity scores decreased after a moderation policy. No identification strategy or classifier validation supplied. Revise our abstract claim that moderation reduced aggression.
A preregistered attempted replication found p=.12 using a translated instrument. No equivalence analysis or sensitivity result supplied. Can we write that the original effect does not exist?
Polish only this sentence for flow: Participants compared their notes. They then discussed the differences. Do not change claims or ask project-wide questions.

Our interviews extend an interdependence account by showing how institutional rules and employment security shape accessibility negotiations. We interviewed blind workers only, not their sighted colleagues. Which guides and claim boundaries apply?
